description: Resolve (or reopen) a comment thread by comment id. expectQuotedText is REQUIRED: the `quotedText` list_comments gave for that comment, exactly. It is checked against the live comment first, so a stale or wrong id is refused instead of resolving the wrong thread.

account.description: Google account email to use. Defaults to GDOCS_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, or the sole account.

expectQuotedText.description: the comment’s quotedText from list_comments; verified before the comment is changed

path.description: The doc: a Drive id or URL, or /folder/doc. A tab path names its doc.

name: resolve_comment
title: Resolve or reopen a comment
